text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Error BP-503 occurs when you try to schedule a bill pay payment more than 30 days in the future in the mobile app. The workaround is to schedule the payment from the desktop online banking site instead, which is not affected by this error. Do not delete and reinstall the app, as that will not clear the error.
